description: Ruth Kelleher has received a call from Marian Prowse about the deposit deadline. Ruth is aware that the deposit must be in Marian's account by end of Wednesday 16th September. Ruth has not yet paid the deposit herself and is waiting to see how the group will handle it.
Dev Sandhu has expressed enthusiasm for the trip twice in the thread but has not yet paid any deposit. He is aware of the deadline.
Nina Achebe has not replied to the thread about the trip. She is aware of the deposit requirement but has not communicated her decision.
Marian Prowse is holding the week for the group until end of Wednesday 16th September. She has not yet received any deposit.
Dev sees his current account balance is £140, not enough for the £200 deposit.

Dev posts a message in the group chat explaining that he had a £620 clutch bill two weeks ago, won't be paid until the 28th, and asks if there's any flexibility on the deposit deadline or if someone can lend him £200 until payday.
Dev's message arrives in the group chat and is now available to Ruth, but she has not yet seen it.
Ruth puts her phone down after the call and looks at the group chat, seeing no new messages from Dev or Nina about the deposit.
Ruth sends a group message to Dev and Nina reminding them of the Wednesday deadline and asking if each can transfer £200 to Marian.
Dev Sandhu reads the thread again, sees Nina hasn't replied, and decides to wait a bit longer before paying. He puts his phone down and continues with his evening.
Dev's message arrives on Nina's phone but she does not notice it; she is occupied with her mother's care and not checking the group chat.
Ruth's group message arrives on Dev's phone, but he does not see it yet as he is not looking at his phone.
Ruth's message arrives on Dev's phone, but he is not currently looking at it.
Dev's phone buzzes with the incoming message, but he does not pick it up or look at it. The message remains unread on his phone.
Dev Sandhu checks the group chat and sees Ruth's message reminding everyone of the Wednesday deadline, but no replies to his own request for flexibility or a loan.
Ruth checks the group chat and sees Dev's message about his clutch bill and request for flexibility or a loan.

Ruth posts a message in the group chat acknowledging Dev's situation, stating that the deposit deadline is fixed per Marian, that she cannot lend £200, and asking if Nina can cover Dev's share or if they need to let the cottage go.
Dev's phone buzzes with Ruth's latest message, but he does not check it.
The messages from Dev and Ruth remain unread on Marian's phone; she does not notice them now.

Ruth types and sends a reply to the group chat: 'Dev, sorry to hear about the clutch. I can't lend the money, I'm afraid. Maybe we can all chip in a bit extra to cover your share? Or Marian might be flexible if we explain? What do you think, Nina? Let's sort this out soon.'
Ruth's latest message arrives on Dev's phone, but he does not notice it.
Dev Sandhu sends a private message to Ruth Kelleher asking if she can lend him £200 until payday on the 28th, explaining the clutch bill.
Dev's private message arrives on Ruth's phone but she does not notice it.
Dev's private message arrives on Ruth's phone and she notices it.

Ruth types and sends a reply to Dev's private message: 'I'm sorry but I can't lend £200 due to my own finances and the history with the group meal last year. Maybe ask Nina or consider letting the cottage go if we can't get the deposit together.'
Dev's phone buzzes with Ruth's private message, but he does not pick it up or look at it. The message remains unread on his phone.
Ruth notices Dev's private message asking if she can lend him £200 until payday.
Dev picks up his phone and sees the unread messages: Ruth's group reminder, her reply about the deposit, and her private message declining the loan.
Dev sends a private message to Nina asking if she can lend him £200 until payday on the 28th, explaining the clutch bill and that Ruth can't help.
Dev has read the messages and now knows that Ruth cannot lend him the money and that the deposit deadline is fixed. He has no new messages from Nina or Marian.
Dev's private message arrives on Nina's phone, but she does not notice it; she is busy with her mother and not checking the group chat or private messages.
Dev's private message to Nina asking for a £200 loan arrives on Nina's phone.
Dev's private message arrives on Nina's phone, but she does not notice it; she is occupied with her mother and not checking messages.
Dev sends a private message to Nina: 'Hey Nina, just checking if you saw my message about the deposit? No pressure, just need to know either way. Thanks.'
Dev's private message arrives on Nina's phone, but she does not notice it; she is busy with her mother and not checking messages.
Nina's phone buzzes with multiple notifications but she does not pick it up; she is attending to her mother.
Nina's phone continues to buzz with notifications, but she does not pick it up; she is occupied with her mother's care and does not check the group chat or private messages.
Nina's phone continues to buzz with notifications, but she does not pick it up; she is attending to her mother.

Dev sends a group message to Ruth, Nina, and Marian stating he still can't afford the deposit due to the clutch bill, that he's asked Nina privately but hasn't heard back, and asking if anyone can suggest a solution or if Marian can offer flexibility on the deadline.
Dev's group message arrives on Ruth's phone but she does not see it; she is occupied with other things.
Dev's group message arrives on Marian's phone, but she does not notice it; she is occupied with other tasks.
Dev's group message arrives on Ruth's phone and is available for her to see, but she has not yet noticed it.
Ruth's phone receives Dev's group message, but she does not notice it.
Dev sends a message to the group chat saying he has to drop out of the trip due to not being able to afford the deposit and no one being able to help.
Dev's message saying he has to drop out arrives on Nina's phone, but she does not notice it; she is attending to her mother.
Dev's message arrives on Ruth's phone, but she does not notice it yet.
Ruth's phone receives Dev's messages but she does not notice them; she remains occupied and does not check her phone.

Marian picks up her phone in the evening and sees the unread messages from the group chat: Dev's initial message about the clutch bill, Ruth's reply, Dev's later message asking for flexibility, and Dev's message saying he has to drop out.
Ruth picks up her phone and sees the notifications from the group chat, including Dev's messages about his clutch bill, his request for flexibility, and his decision to drop out.
Ruth sends a private message to Nina asking if she's still interested and proposing options.
Ruth's private message arrives on Nina's phone, but Nina does not notice it; she is attending to her mother.

Nina picks up her phone and sees the multiple notifications from the group chat and private messages from Dev and Ruth, including Dev's initial message, Ruth's reminders, Dev's loan request, his follow-up, his dropping out, and Ruth's latest private message.

Nina sends a message in the group chat explaining that her mother came out of hospital three weeks ago, she doesn't know her October schedule yet, so she can't commit to the trip or pay the deposit, and she apologizes for not replying sooner.

Nina reads through the messages, taking in the full thread: Dev's clutch bill, his request for a loan, his dropping out, and Ruth's private message asking if she's still interested and proposing options.
Nina's group chat message arrives on Ruth's phone, but Ruth does not notice it.
Nina's message arrives on Dev's phone, but he does not notice it; he is not currently checking his phone.
Nina's message arrives on Marian's phone, but Marian does not notice it; she is occupied with other tasks.
Nina's message is sent to the group chat, now available to Ruth, Dev, and Marian.
Nina's group chat message remains unread on Ruth's phone; Ruth does not notice it.
Nina's message arrives on Ruth's phone, but Ruth does not notice it; she is occupied with other things.
Ruth's phone sits untouched; she does not pick it up or look at it. The messages from Nina remain unread on her phone.
Ruth calls Nina's phone. The call rings but Nina does not answer; she is tending to her mother and does not pick up. The call goes to voicemail.
Ruth hears Nina's voicemail greeting and has the option to leave a message or hang up.
Ruth sees the notification of Nina's group chat message on her phone and opens the chat to read it.
Ruth calls Marian Prowse's phone. The call rings.
Marian Prowse's phone rings. She is occupied with other tasks and does not notice the call; it continues ringing.

Ruth leaves a voicemail for Nina saying: 'Hi Nina, it's Ruth. I'm calling about the cottage. Dev has dropped out, so it's just us. The deposit deadline is tomorrow end of day. If you're still in, we each need to pay £300 to Marian by then. If not, I'll have to let the cottage go. Please call me back as soon as you can.'
The call from Ruth to Marian continues to ring, but Marian does not notice or answer it; it goes to voicemail.
Ruth's call to Marian Prowse rings on Marian's phone, but Marian does not answer; the call goes to voicemail.
The call goes to voicemail and Ruth's message is recorded on Marian's phone, but Marian does not notice it.
Marian sees her bank balance and that no £600 deposit has arrived.
Marian notices the notification of a new message in the group chat on her phone.
Marian opens the group chat and reads Nina's message explaining she can't commit to the trip or deposit due to her mother's care, and Dev's message saying he has to drop out.
Marian opens the group chat and reads Nina's message explaining that her mother came out of hospital and she can't commit to the trip or pay the deposit.

Marian sends a message to the group chat: 'Hi all, I've seen the messages. Since no deposit has arrived and it sounds like the group isn't going ahead, I'm going to release the week to the couple from Leeds who've asked about it. If there's any change, let me know by the end of Wednesday as originally agreed.'
Marian's message arrives on Ruth's phone, but Ruth does not notice it.
Marian's message arrives on Nina's phone, but Nina does not notice it; she is attending to her mother.
Marian's message arrives on Ruth's phone, but she does not notice it.
Marian's message arrives on Ruth's phone as a notification, but Ruth does not notice it.
Marian's message notification appears on Ruth's phone screen, but Ruth does not notice it; she is not currently looking at her phone.
Dev picks up his phone and notices the unread messages from the group chat: Nina's message explaining she can't commit, and Marian's message about releasing the week.
